title: Anthropic shares fall below IPO price. Traders see even more pain
summary_full: Anthropic shares fell below the $83 IPO price as options activity surged, with large put buys, call buys and put sales pointing to a divided market.
summary_public: Anthropic shares fell below the $83 IPO price as options activity surged, with large put buys, call buys and put sales pointing to a divided market.
